text:
ashwin: quick heads-up — after rolling route-priority v2 to 20% canary were seeing invoice-preview deltas for some tenants. Preview shows "missing" tokens from the source tenant for long-lived sessions. anyone on call?

maria: saw the alert. preview pipeline shows ~1.8% token shortfall concentrated on sessions >30m. stack traces are noisy.

kevin: my initial hunch: we started emitting a small tombstone event on route reassigns to avoid double-counting during rebalancer flips. looks like those tombstones are being swallowed under bursty ingest backpressure.

sophie: tombstones? I thought the rebalancer handled idempotency only in state. can you paste an example event?

kevin: example from producer v2: ```{"type":"route_swap","session_id":"sess-7a9","from_tenant":"acme","to_tenant":"acme-2","delta_tokens":-120}```

mike: ah — proxy had a filter to drop non-usage types to protect the tally consumer schema. that explains it: we never send the negative delta to the tally, so the destination sees +120 but origin isnt decremented. net tokens are inflated on the receiving tenant.

maria: options laid out: A) convert tombstones to normal usage records with negative token field; B) teach tally consumer to understand route_swap and apply delta; C) run a reconciliation replay for the affected window from ingress buffer.

ashwin: business asks for a quick mitigation — finance is seeing enterprise preview deltas and is alarmed. we need a low-risk fast path and a safe permanent fix.

kevin: B is the clean semantic fix but touches the hotpath consumer. risk: branch in consumer could add overhead to p99. If we gate it behind a feature flag and canary, we can limit exposure.

sophie: A is low-risk at producer side but requires schema contract change (sending negative usage), which could be surprising for downstream consumers expecting non-negative tokens.

mike: C buys us time but customers invoices could be wrong for several hours. replay will correct ledger but not instantaneous.

invoice-bot: Alert: invoice-preview-delta > 0.5% for tenants tagged enterprise at 2026-03-21T10:32Z.

maria: pragmatic mitigation: enable preview service sampling fallback — for sessions with last attribution >5m use clientlib session-owner mapping instead of preview aggregation. reduces visible deltas while we fix plumbing. low blast radius.

kevin: proposed rollout plan (priority): implement (B) behind a flag enable_route_swap_handling, with a minimal schema surface: keep token_field name intact, consume route_swap where delta_tokens may be negative. add microbench perf tests.

mike: Ill own rollout runbook and dashboards. dashboards to add: invoice_preview_delta_by_tenant, consumer_p99_ms, replay_backlog, tombstone_accept_rate.

sophie: Ill add an e2e case for console preview that synthesizes a route_swap + normal usage stream and validates preview equals final ledger after reconciliation. also add unit tests for negative-token handling.

maria: deployment steps: 
- add route_swap branch in tally consumer (feature-flagged)
- local perf + unit tests
- canary consumer deploy to 5% -> 25% if metrics stable
- trigger ingress-buffer replay for 10m window if preview delta not improving
- monitor alerts for >1% sustained delta or consumer_p99 regressions

kevin: follow-up: we should reingest missing tombstones. I'll schedule a replay from the ingest buffer for window 2026-03-21T10:10:00..10:40:00 and mark replay with metadata reingest_reason=route_swap_miss.

ashwin: owners: kevin -> replay + producer patch; maria -> consumer change; sophie -> console tests; mike -> dashboards + runbook. Ill coordinate the canary.

mike: creating tickets now and linking to this thread. also adding a temporary dashboard panel to show "preview vs ledger delta" per tenant.

maria: note for the consumer change: keep the hot path fast — route_swap should map to the same aggregation path as usage records (no additional lookups). preserve idempotency by using session_id+event_id dedupe.

sophie: one more thought: add an integration check in the ingress proxy to ensure that any non-usage event with delta_tokens is forwarded. that guards against future filter regressions.

ashwin: good idea. implement lightweight proxy pass-through for tombstone types and flag it in canary.

mike: timeline: consumer PR today, canary tomorrow morning, replay after canary if needed.

ashwin: thanks all. keep replies small here — update when PRs are merged or if metrics breach thresholds.
